group: Book of Ether/Book of Ether and the Flood/ether-flood
description: One way that the writings of the prophets helps us is by drawing our attention to other stories from the scriptures, which support, strengthen, and encourage us to act with faith and follow those prophets' teachings. One example of this can be found in Moroni’s abridgment of the record of Ether. Moroni’s selection of words in this account of the Jaredites points the reader to similar language in the story of the Flood.
